description_en: Queries the details of a collector instance
description_zh: 获取采集器实例的详细信息
name: DescribeCollector

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the collector
parameters.name: res_id

collectorPaths.description_en: The list of Filebeat collection paths

configs.description_en: The configuration file information of the collector
configs.description_zh: 采集器的配置文件信息

dryRun.description_en:
Specifies whether to only validate the collector without creating it. Valid values:

true: validates the configuration without creating the collector.
false: validates the configuration and creates the collector
dryRun.description_zh:
是否校验并创建采集器。支持：

true：只校验不创建
false：校验并创建

extendConfigs.description_en: The extended configurations of the collector

configType.description_en:
The configuration type. Valid values:

collectorTargetInstance: the output of the collector.
collectorDeployMachine: the machine on which the collector is deployed.
collectorElasticsearchForKibana: the information about the Elasticsearch instance that supports the Kibana dashboard
configType.description_zh:
配置类型。支持：

collectorTargetInstance：采集器Output
collectorDeployMachine：采集器的部署机器
collectorElasticsearchForKibana：支持Kibana仪表盘的Elasticsearch实例信息

enableMonitoring.description_en:
Specifies whether to enable monitoring. This parameter is displayed when configType is set to collectorTargetInstance. Valid values:

true: enables monitoring.

false: disables monitoring
enableMonitoring.description_zh:
是否启用Monitoring，当configType为collectorTargetInstance时显示。支持：

true：启用

false：不启用

groupId.description_en: The ID of the machine group. This parameter is displayed when configType is set to collectorDeployMachine

host.description_en: The private endpoint of Kibana after the Kibana dashboard is enabled. This parameter is displayed when configType is set to collectorElasticsearchForKibana
host.description_zh: 启用Kibana Dashboard后，Kibana的私网地址。当configType为collectorElasticsearchForKibana时显示

hosts.description_en: The list of host addresses of the target instance for the collector
hosts.description_zh: 采集器目标实例的主机地址列表

items.description_en: The list of access addresses of the instance specified in the collector output. This parameter is displayed when configType is set to collectorTargetInstance
items.description_zh: 采集器Output指定实例的访问地址列表。当configType为collectorTargetInstance时显示

instanceId.description_en: Instance ID of the instance associated with the collector. If configType is set to collectorTargetInstance, this parameter indicates instance ID of the instance specified in the collector output. If configType is set to collectorDeployMachines and type is set to ACKCluster, this parameter indicates instance ID of the ACK cluster
instanceId.description_zh: 采集器关联的实例ID。当configType为collectorTargetInstance时，为采集器Output的实例ID；当configType为collectorDeployMachines，且type为ACKCluster时，为ACK（容器Kubernetes）集群ID

instanceType.description_en: The type of the instance specified in the collector output. Valid values: elasticsearch and logstash. This parameter is displayed when configType is set to collectorTargetInstance
instanceType.description_zh: 采集器Output指定的实例类型。支持elasticsearch、logstash。当configType为collectorTargetInstance时显示

kibanaHost.description_en: The public network access address of Kibana after the Kibana dashboard is enabled. This parameter is displayed when configType is set to collectorElasticsearchForKibana
kibanaHost.description_zh: 启用Kibana Dashboard后，Kibana的公网访问地址。当configType为collectorElasticsearchForKibana时显示

machines.description_en: The list of ECS instances on which the collector is deployed. This parameter is displayed when configType is set to collectorDeployMachines and type is set to ECSInstanceId
machines.description_zh: 采集器所部署的ECS机器列表信息。当configType为collectorDeployMachines，且type为ECSInstanceId时显示

agentStatus.description_en:
The status of each collector on the ECS instance. Valid values:

heartOk: The heartbeat is normal.
heartLost: The heartbeat is abnormal.
uninstalled: The collector is not installed.
failed: The installation failed
agentStatus.description_zh:
ECS上各采集器的状态。支持：

heartOk：心跳正常
heartLost：心跳异常
uninstalled：未安装
failed：安装失败

instanceId.description_en: The list of ECS instance IDs

protocol.description_en: The transmission protocol. This protocol must be consistent with the access protocol of the instance specified in the collector output. Valid values: HTTP and HTTPS. This parameter is displayed when configType is set to collectorTargetInstance
protocol.description_zh: 传输协议，需要与采集器Output指定实例的访问协议保持一致。支持HTTP、HTTPS。当configType为collectorTargetInstance时显示

successPodsCount.description_en: The number of pods from which data is successfully collected in the ACK cluster
successPodsCount.description_zh: ACK集群所有采集成功的Pod节点数

totalPodsCount.description_en: The total number of pods from which data is collected in the ACK cluster
totalPodsCount.description_zh: ACK集群所有采集的Pod节点数

type.description_en:
The type of the machine on which the collector is deployed. This parameter is displayed when configType is set to collectorDeployMachine. Valid values:

ECSInstanceId: ECS instance.
ACKCluster: ACK cluster
type.description_zh:
采集器部署的机器类型，当configType为collectorDeployMachine时显示。支持：

ECSInstanceId：ECS
ACKCluster：容器Kubernetes

userName.description_en: The username used to access the instance specified in the collector output. Default value: elastic. This parameter is displayed when configType is set to collectorTargetInstance or collectorElasticsearchForKibana
userName.description_zh: 采集器Output指定实例的访问用户名，默认为elastic。当configType为collectorTargetInstance或collectorElasticsearchForKibana时显示

gmtCreatedTime.description_en: The time when the collector was created

gmtUpdateTime.description_en: The time when the collector was updated

resId.description_en: The instance ID of the collector

resType.description_en: The type of the collector. Valid values: fileBeat, metricBeat, heartBeat, and auditBeat

status.description_en:
The status of the collector. Valid values:

activing: activating.
active: activated
status.description_zh:
采集器状态。支持：

activing：生效中
active：已生效

vpcId.description_en: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) where the collector is deployed
vpcId.description_zh: 采集器所在的专有网络ID
